The scholarships and fellowships on these pages typically provide funding for opportunities that support an undergraduate course of study (e.g. STEM research, intensive language study) or graduate research. Some offer practical experience, like service or teaching English abroad.  

Our fellowship pages strive to reflect the language used by the sponsoring organizations or foundations.

Opportunities that may be open to international students are indicated with an *.

Opportunities by Location

Temple University Opportunities

For first-year undergraduates, sophomores, or juniors

  • College of Science and Technology Undergraduate Research Program (URP)*
  • Creative Arts, Research and Scholarship (CARAS) Program*
  • Diamond Peer Teachers*
  • Diamond Research Scholars* 
  • School-based Scholarships*
  • Smith Scholars
  • PECO Scholarships
  • University-wide Awards*

(For financial aid and need-based awards, see Student Financial Services)

For graduate students

  • Center for Humanity at Temple (CHAT) Fellowships*
  • The Graduate School's Fellowship page
For Graduate Study in the United States

For first-year undergraduates, sophomores, or juniors.

  • Beinecke Scholarship
  • Truman Scholarship (campus nomination required)

For seniors and recent alumni

  • Knight-Hennessy Scholars* (campus nomination encouraged for seniors and very recent alumni)
  • Payne, Pickering, and Rangel Fellowships
  • QUAD Fellowship (STEM)*
  • Samvid Scholars
  • Soros Scholarship for New Americans*
For Study in the United Kingdom/Ireland

For first-year undergraduates, sophomores, or juniors

  • Fulbright UK Summer Institutes

For seniors and recent alumni

  • Gates*
  • Marshall (campus nomination required)
  • Mitchell (campus nomination required for senior applicants)
  • Rhodes* (campus nomination required)

  • Luce Scholars (Asia)
  • McCall MacBain Scholarship* (Canada)
  • Princeton in Africa (PiAf), Princeton in Asia (PiA), and Princeton in Latin America (PiLA)
